messages:
Maya (partnerships): Quick proposal  run a 3-week 'Tooling Sandpit' for ISV/tooling partners (LangChain, LlamaIndex), gateways, orchestration runners, and 2 HW SIs. Objective: surface adapter/kernel/SSO nits, generate one co-demo, and produce a short integration findings doc. Essentials: auto-provision test keys, small compute credit pool, simple manifest, SSO options, and a shared smoke harness.

Owen (devex): Onboarding goal: <15m. We'll do a one-click test key and an inline checklist. Need callback URIs for gateway adaptors.

Chen (eng-runtime): Manifest should include model, seq_buckets, quant, autoscale_hint, and latency_slo. HW partners want perf numbers by variant. Also watch KV cache interactions with LlamaIndex adapters.

Maya (partnerships): Chen, can you drop a tiny manifest sketch by Tue? keep it minimal.

Chen (eng-runtime): Yes. Sketch will be in the repo; example in thread: `model: open/redwood-edge-1 | seq: [128,512,2048] | quant: 4bit-ptq | latency_slo_ms: 120`

integrations-bot: Sandbox CI snapshot: a100: 8/9 smoke tests passed; t4: 7/9; arm-edge: 5/9. Failures mostly on long-seq memory spikes. Full run: (internal link)

Ava (product): Marketing wants a co-demo + blog the week after. Legal needs a short sandbox addendum for logs/retention. Partnerships to coordinate legal + marketing signoff.

Luca (bizops): Budget note: request 30k compute credits + 2 demo stipends. I'll file the request and flag PO windows.

Maya (partnerships): Owners: Partnerships = invites/comms; DevEx = onboarding + SSO; Eng-runtime = harness + manifests; Product = co-demo; BizOps = credits. Deadlines: manifest Tue, onboarding Fri, invites Wed.

Owen (devex): I'll add SP/IdP SAML and OIDC testcases and mock IdP for partners without SAML. Also will publish a quick smoke curl for docs.

Chen (eng-runtime): Note: the smoke endpoint exercises continuous batching. Warn partners about high parallel fans and queue depth. We'll add `autoscale_hint` to the manifest.

Maya (partnerships): Who can ping LangChain & LlamaIndex maintainers for a quick yes/no? want confirmations before invites go out.

Ava (product): I'll reach out to LangChain. Maya please ping LlamaIndex & gateway maintainers. I'll own the co-demo outline.

integrations-bot: Reminder: planned infra maintenance Thursday 03:00-04:00 UTC. Avoid long seq runs during blackout.

Maya (partnerships): Recap actions: (1) Chen opens manifest PR, (2) Owen publishes onboarding + smoke snippets, (3) Partnerships sends invites Wed, (4) Product drafts co-demo. I'll drop a one-pager and calendar invite now. Any gaps?

Luca (bizops): Adding stipend line to the PO. Will update once approved.

Owen (devex): Add SSO test checklist to the onboarding doc; include sample callback URLs for gateway webhooks.

Maya (partnerships): Great, thanks all. Follow-up Loom + invite incoming. :tada:
